mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces the cost of capital and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the months when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2% (as of the signal date) over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month sequential increase in CPIAUCSL above 0.5% per month signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 3 months, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strong labor market and robust housing demand, indicating broad economic strength and supporting corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE declines and HOUST rises simultaneously, the S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market overheating and impending inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, when UNRATE declines, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 60-day SPX returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 thousand units signals weakening residential demand, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1000 thousand units in 3 months
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1000 thousand units in 3 months, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which depresses corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS and HOUST both decline, the S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals a deteriorating labor market and economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises above 5.0%, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over the last 5 years.
